title: APD Gauntlet shared schema definitions
description: Reusable $defs for patterns referenced across multiple record schemas. Edit here; other schemas $ref into this file rather than duplicating the regex.

attack_technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID; accepts both top-level (T1078) and sub-technique (T1078.001) forms.

attack_technique_id_topline.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID at top-level only (no sub-technique). Used where the schema author wants to constrain to parent techniques and carry the sub_technique value in a sibling field.

attack_sub_technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK sub-technique ID (e.g. T1078.001). Nullable so callers can record 'no sub-technique applicable' explicitly.

attack_mitigation_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK enterprise mitigation ID (e.g. M1041).

d3fend_id.description: MITRE D3FEND short code. Real D3FEND data uses 2-to-7 letter codes (e.g. D3-NTA, D3-NTSA, D3-PHDURA).
